goal: Retrieve the two ancestor events by document ID (AZ-i-v43CigTi6WRhP2K and AZ-jAP43CigTi6XiiWh3) from logs-system.auth to identify the workstation host, prod-tier host, user, auth method, and outcome for each SSH event in the cross-tier pivot alert.
what_to_summarize: user.name or user extracted from message field
full message field content including sshd Accepted/Failed line with auth method (password/publickey)
source IP if present in message

params.query: _id: ("AZ-i-v43CigTi6WRhP2K" OR "AZ-jAP43CigTi6XiiWh3")

goal: Query all sshd authentication events on prod-tier hosts (db-*, web-*, jump-box-*) in the logs-system.auth index around July 25 2026 to identify whether there is a brute-force pattern (multiple failed attempts) or a single successful login.
what_to_summarize: all sshd Accepted and Failed events on db-*, web-*, jump-box-* hosts in the window
count of failed vs successful attempts per host
user names and source IPs from message fields
auth method (password vs publickey) from message content
any pattern of rapid sequential failures followed by success (brute-force signature)

params.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE _id == "AZ-i-v43CigTi6WRhP2K" OR _id == "AZ-jAP43CigTi6XiiWh3"
| KEEP @timestamp, host.name, user.name, source.ip, event.outcome, message, _id
| SORT @timestamp

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE id == "AZ-i-v43CigTi6WRhP2K" OR id == "AZ-jAP43CigTi6XiiWh3"
| KEEP @timestamp, host.name, user.name, source.ip, event.outcome, message, id
| SORT @timestamp

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-27T09:30:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-27T10:00:00Z"
        AND (host.name LIKE "db-*" OR host.name LIKE "web-*" OR host.name LIKE "jump-box-*")
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
| STATS accepted   = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "success",
        failed     = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "failure",
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY auth_method = CASE(message LIKE "*publickey*", "publickey",
                              message LIKE "*password*",  "password", "other"),
           source.ip, host.name, user.name
| SORT first_seen

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-27T09:30:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-27T10:00:00Z"
        AND (host.name LIKE "db-*" OR host.name LIKE "web-*" OR host.name LIKE "jump-box-*")
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
| EVAL auth_method = CASE(message LIKE "*publickey*", "publickey",
                          message LIKE "*password*",  "password", "other")
| KEEP @timestamp, host.name, user.name, source.ip, event.outcome, auth_method, message
| SORT @timestamp

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-27T09:30:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-27T10:00:00Z"
        AND (host.name LIKE "db-*" OR host.name LIKE "web-*" OR host.name LIKE "jump-box-*")
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
| STATS accepted = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "success",
        failed   = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "failure",
        first    = MIN(@timestamp),
        last     = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY host.name, source.ip, user.name
| SORT failed DESC, accepted DESC

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-27T09:30:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-27T10:00:00Z"
        AND (host.name LIKE "db-*" OR host.name LIKE "web-*" OR host.name LIKE "jump-box-*")
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
| STATS accepted = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "success",
        failed   = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "failure",
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY host.name, source.ip, user.name
| SORT failed DESC, accepted DESC
